svg.title: Confined aquifer and artesian head
svg.desc: Original conceptual scientific diagram with live labels and separate editable components. See caption and sources.

text.tspan: A static standpipe measurement in a conceptual geological section
Static measurement shown: the pipe rim is above its water level.
A separate outlet below available head may flow; discharge changes the local head.
Conceptual section; local head marker only. Geometry and vertical exaggeration are illustrative; no field measurements implied.
